headline_seed: Man kills seven of his children, and an eighth child, in Louisiana mass shooting
description_seed: The children, aged from one to 14 years old, were killed in a shooting that police are describing as a "domestic disturbance".

what: Man kills seven of his children, and an eighth child, in Louisiana mass shooting

clean_source_blocks.text: The children, aged from one to 14 years old, were killed in a shooting that police are describing as a "domestic disturbance".
A father has killed seven of his children and an unrelated child in a mass shooting in Shreveport in the US state of Louisiana that police have described as a "domestic disturbance".
SHREVEPORT, La. (KSLA/Gray News) - Eight children were killed in a mass shooting that began as a domestic dispute, according to police.
Shreveport, Louisiana, police identified Shamar Elkins as the suspect in the shooting that killed eight children, including a 1-year-old, calling it a “heinous act.”
